metadata.notes: [public]: Weekly. Imprint varies. Published [9?] February 1917 to 29 August 1969 as <i>Irma times</i>. 3 September 1969 amalgamated with <i>Viking news</i> to form <i>Viking news and Irma times</i>. Publication suspended 28 March to 14 May 1925.
